title: Diverse, but Divisive: LLMs Can Exaggerate Gender Differences in Opinion Related to Harms of Misinformation
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the ability of LLMs to evaluate 'group harm' (a core ethical concept) across socially and morally sensitive topics such as abortion and LGBTQ rights. It explicitly frames its investigation within the context of procedural justice and the ethics of algorithmic claim prioritization.
